title: Dark Marvels
description:

description:

Exploring the dark origin stories behind some of history's most notorious methods of execution, from the guillotine to the electric chair.

title: Dark Marvels
description:

Whether they're used to stop treasure hunters, body snatchers, or wartime enemies, booby traps are diabolical devices just waiting to kill.

title: Dark Marvels
description:

From the destructive Viking axe to the sacred but deadly Samurai katana, checking out razor sharp blades wielded by fearsome warriors that have spilled blood and forged empires.

description:

The twisted origin stories of some of history's most diabolically creative and brutal torture devices, from the "Iron Maiden" to the pear of anguish.

From the world's largest trebuchet to Nazi super cannons, these are the deadly weapons that rain destruction and spread fear on the battlefield.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E09 — Khanda
The bladesmiths must create a weapon in their signature style from a large pile of mixed metal that is welded together; two return home to forge the mysterious Khanda.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E10 — Branch Battle: Army
Top bladesmiths from each branch of the U.S. military compete to earn a spot in a battle; four U.S. Army soldiers must forge a special forces V-42 stiletto; two smiths are dispatched to their home forges to build a U.S. Army officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E11 — Branch Battle: Air Force
In Round 2, four airmen from the U.S. Air Force must forge a bolo knife using the san mai technique to combine high carbon steel with helicopter parts; two smiths return home to forge an Air Force NCO sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E12 — Branch Battle: Marines
Four Marines must forge one of the most versatile, and iconic combat knives in history: the KA-BAR.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E13 — Branch Battle: Navy
Four U.S. Navy officers must forge a multipurpose naval Mark 3 dive knife with metal from a giant anchor chain; two sailors return home to re-create the intricate and iconic naval officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E14 — Branch Battle: Finals
Tasked with replicating an iconic M3 Trench Knife from layered Damascus in only three hours; two servicemen persevere and head home to recreate a legendary sword: General George Washington's Lion-headed Cuttoe.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S07 E09 — Military Tribute
In honor of Veterans Day, four bladesmiths pay tribute in a special military themed competition, forging their blades from a panzer tank; two smiths have four days to recreate the Scottish Backsword as famously wielded by Captain Mad Jack Churchill.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E07 — Thread the Needle
A returning challenge receives a daring makeover; the Rutgers Security Six revolver; contestants try to cleanly fire a bullet through a narrow tube.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E08 — Familiar Foes
The remaining competitors face the most extreme trick shots of seasons past; contestants open capped bottles, blow cotton swabs to bits and knock soda cans out of the air; two players must successfully man Hotchkiss Cannons.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E09 — Big Boom
Competitors blast clay birds mid-flight with Benelli shotguns; the crossbow pits two competitors against each other.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E10 — Zip or Ship
The marksmen are strapped to a mechanical arm and sent soaring with the SP89; two competitors zoom down a zip line course.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E11 — A Game of Horse
The marksmen fire the Browning M1919 from a rolling Army half-track; competitors call the shots in a game of horse.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E12 — Last Man Standing
The final four must crawl through a tunnel, dodge barbed wire and slither through mud with an AK-47.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E13 — Season 3 Behind the Bullet
Unseen footage reveals the inside scoop on all 16 contestants.
